awareness.title: Nature needs us now
awareness.body: Wildlife populations we monitor have declined by an average of {{percent}} since 1970. Over {{threatened}} species assessed by the IUCN are threatened with extinction. But conservation works — Bangladesh's tiger count has been rising again.
tips: Never buy products made from wildlife — skins, shells, ivory or exotic pets.
Use less plastic: much of it ends up in our rivers and the Bay of Bengal.
Plant native trees and flowers to feed bees, butterflies and birds.
Respect the hilsa fishing ban seasons that let fish breed.
Share what you learn — awareness is the start of protection.
